scope: Bind the qualified supplied-reader directory/name correspondence collector to an already constrained held Windows ordinary file, with automatic/explicit NTFS3.0/3.1 selection, retained exact responses, source checks and pure reconstruction. No new worker/public command kind, physical source, writer, lookup/collation/complete namespace/content or original 0.1.0 qualification.
ownership: Extend the existing ntfs_file.h/.cpp owner and its real test seam; reuse local_file source/ancestor pinning and one opener. Add a private typed NtfsMembershipFileRequest around the existing directory-file controls plus targets 1..256. Dispatch the sealed supplied-reader observer; no second parser, source opener, provider hierarchy or scheduler. Keep NtfsSnapshotKind, snapshots, workers and public command forms unchanged in this file-only unit. Existing old bootstrap/directory results and native trace remain compatible.
controls: Copy the complete request, callback and test controls before opening or any callback. Validate source-window/signed seek/profile/global capture/directory/target quotas before opening. Target limits remain independent of existing global quotas, with no automatic growth. Reject unsupported controls before any native source access.
source: Open only an explicit allowed ordinary file with the existing native read/pin/binding policy. One live held source supplies bootstrap, directory graph, target/list/extension and final exact rereads. Retain each response including partial/error/cancel results. Do not open a filename from disk metadata or acquire a target through an OS path.
automatic_profile: Preserve the current graph-mode3.1 probe and3.0 prefix continuation: validate every retained response and selected bootstrap foundation before permitting new native reads. Bind requested directory and target controls to both passes. Reuse the same original response prefix without reopening or duplicating native reads; successful automatic3.0 has exactly the explicit 3.0 native trace. Prefix/replay mutations withdraw applicability. Preserve old-mode foundation serialization/hashes.
outcomes: Keep collection completeness, exact correspondence, source bindings/metadata, replay equality and applicability separate. Fully acquired name mismatch remains complete nonapplicable observed evidence; source errors/stale/unsupported/quota/change produce bounded incomplete prefixes. No atomic snapshot, current-source mutation authority, namespace/lookup/uniqueness/collation/content or effect authorization is granted. Error wrappers must not turn malformed evidence into a mere mismatch.
reconstruction: Re-run the same pure observer only against exact retained ordered responses after live acquisition. Validate requested extents, response bytes, flags/errors and complete trace consumption; compare exact owned observation bytes. Preserve requested source/window/profile/epoch and all membership controls. Every native read/byte and retained/attribute/run/output quota stays global across all phases; pure replay is bounded separately and does not cause native reads.
testing: Use actual generated disposable ordinary files from independent MembershipVolume recipes and expected raw tuples/read order/hashes defined before evaluation. Cover both profiles and automatic selection, root/nonroot/empty/deep/fragmented/list/bitmap/target-extension cases, hardlinks/identical aliases/raw names, complete mismatches, invalid/stale/changed/budget-limited evidence and every acquisition/final/pure-replay failure. Exercise invalid controls before opens, source/ancestor binding and later release, callback mutation/cancellation, prefix provenance and strict no-extra-native-read continuation. Retain whole generated-file hashes before/after. Preserve all old native file/worker/public and shared ordinary-file behavior. Fresh exact-source all-target build, the explicit 31-group affected regression set, headers/imports/C90/tooling/context validation and implementing-agent review before integration; unavailable hosts/symlinks stay unverified.
acceptance: One held ordinary file produces independently expected source-bound correspondence with exact unchanged source hashes and finite controls.
Automatic3.0 reuses only its validated prefix and has exactly the explicit 3.0 native trace; mutations, errors, mismatch and incomplete evidence remain distinguishable.

Normal/fault source compositions, the explicit 31-group old/new native set, headers/imports/C90/tooling/context and source inventory have exact retained source/evidence. No worker/public/release/storage authority is implied.

qualification.scope: All-target fresh pinned x64 build, every current NTFS regression and explicitly selected shared-file/protocol/invocation regressions; selected Win32/WOW64 supplement. Not a full 166-group current campaign or complete Win32 product.
qualification.expansion: If implementation changes common capture/reader/JSON/presentation or other owners beyond this file adapter, resolve impact and broaden the exact native closure before relying on results. Do not silently report selected evidence as complete-suite evidence.

output_model.target_control: capture.domain.target_limit is the decimal requested1..256 target cap; it enters capture_domain and the automatic-profile foundation through requested_target_limit.
output_model.source_checks: Existing capture fields retain metadata/binding/profile/replay facts separately. observed_stable remains the existing aggregate eligibility including observation.applicable; a complete name mismatch has false observed_stable while metadata_equal/replay_equal/binding_checks_ok may all be true. No binding_diagnostic is fabricated for a mere name mismatch.
output_model.authority: authorizes_effects/product_dispatch_admitted/capture.atomic_snapshot remain false; source_consistency stays live-uncoordinated. No worker/snapshot/public schema is expanded.
output_model.compatibility: Existing bootstrap/directory schemas, domain/provider fields, foundation hashes and actual read order stay byte-compatible. Only membership adds the target-limit field and schema/provider identities.
